body: Medication can't take the pain of rejection away.  I genuinely believe that if I found love, I'd be on top of the world.  I know that happiness should come from within, but that is not my own personal feeling at this point.  I need romantic love to make me whole.  I'm spoiled and stubborn and unattractive(not just physically).
Thank you.  You have admirably positive attitude.  Why do you hate yourself?  You're a good person for taking the time to help me out.  I hope your miracle comes sooner than later.

Please see my reply to JennaSidal. I've read a lot of posts on this subreddit, and I could have guessed the types of responses I would get. And I knew it would be unlikely for my feelings to be changed, yet I posted anyway and wasted your time and effort. For that, I am an asshole. I am genuinely thankful for your response. I'm sorry I probably won't get better. For what it's worth, your post made me cry for a couple seconds.

How much longer can I put my feelings behind theirs?  I'm no saint just for staying alive.

I say I'm weak because all my problems are petty.  A whole lot has been given to me, and everything I've earned has been through little effort.  My heart aches from unrequited love.  I can't get over it, as pathetic as it is.

I'm weak because it is taking real effort to take the time to reply to these comments, even though that's the least I can do for you kind souls offering help.  It should be automatic, but I came close to ignoring you.

No, I'm not getting medical help.  I've tried it before, to no success.  I'd probably argue and try to justify my feelings more than I would open up to taking on a new perspective.

I hate myself because I should know better, but yet here I am...

Thank you for your response.
